First Yoruba pass. 20 -> 52 records. THE INVERSION AGAIN: Oshosi, the hunter orisha, was in the registry only as santeria_ochosi -- the diaspora form present and the Yoruba original absent, which is the third instance of this pattern in the programme after Nanaya/sogdian_nana and Lotan/yahwism_leviathan, and is flagged as a class of defect rather than three coincidences. Households were missing members: Oba (senior wife of Shango) in a registry holding Shango, Oya and Oshun; Yemowo in a registry holding Obatala; Aje in a registry holding her parent Olokun. THE OYO LINE: the registry held Shango, Aganju and Ajaka and then nothing -- no Orompoto (first female Alaafin, expelled the Nupe in 1555, founded the cavalry), no Ojigi (brought Dahomey to tribute in 1730), none of the eight eighteenth-century Alaafins destroyed by their own council, no Bashorun Gaa who destroyed four of them, no Abiodun, Aole, Afonja, Oluewu or Atiba, and no Moremi in a registry holding her husband Oranmiyan. 19 of the 32 additions are people rather than gods, and together they make the Oyo constitutional crisis expressible for the first time: the Oyo Mesi's parrot's egg, the Are Ona Kakanfo created by Ajagbo as its counterweight, and both instruments destroying what they were built to protect. 32 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/yoruba-expansion.txt. First Maya pass. 26 -> 90 records. A 79-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 9 hits and 70 absences, and several of the 9 are alias matches rather than holdings (Kisin resolves to maya_ah_puch, Ah Mun to maya_yum_kaax, Chac Chel to maya_ix_chel, God D to maya_itzamna). TWO DISTINCT GAPS. POPOL VUH: the corpus held the principals and almost nobody else in the book -- absent were Hun Batz and Hun Chouen, the elder half-brothers turned into monkeys who are the patron gods of every Maya scribe; their mother Xbaquiyalo; NINE OF THE TWELVE LORDS OF XIBALBA (it held the two supreme lords and exactly one of the ten subordinates, so the paired disease-offices were invisible); Avilix and Hacavitz, without whom Tohil is one god rather than the three that constitute the K'iche' lineage settlement; ALL FOUR of the men made of maize and ALL FOUR of their wives, who are what the book exists to explain; Xulu and Pacam, the seers through whom the Hero Twins arrange their own resurrection; and three of the four destroyers of the wooden people. CLASSIC PERIOD: not one Maya ruler was in the registry -- zero, in a corpus carrying Egyptian pharaohs, Mesopotamian kings, ten Mixtec lords and the whole Mexica tlatoani line. Nor were the gods the Classic inscriptions name: K'awiil (absent from a corpus about to hold SIX kings named after him -- the Ninurta/Ashur pattern again), God L, Pauahtun and the four Bacabs, GI and GIII of the Palenque Triad, Xaman Ek, Buluc Chabtan. 64 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/maya-expansion.txt: 27 Popol Vuh, 11 Classic gods, 23 rulers from six cities, 3 postclassic and colonial. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. The 23 rulers were chosen so the politics reads rather than samples: Tikal against Calakmul with both sides present (the 378 entrada, Stela 31, the Kaanul hegemony under Yuknoom the Great, Jasaw's reversal in 695); Palenque, where a succession through a woman produced the Cross Group theology; Copan and Quirigua, where in 738 a client beheaded the overlord who had installed him; Yaxchilan's Lintels 24 and 25; and El Peru-Waka', where Lady K'abel held kaloomte' and her husband did not. Three of the 23 are women who ruled or outranked. TRADITION-KEY PROBLEM, OBSERVED AND NOT TOUCHED: ALL TWELVE K'iche' records duplicate Maya records of the same Popol Vuh figures, and SEVEN of the twelve Yucatec Maya records duplicate Maya records -- nineteen figures held twice across three keys. Flagged as 11 CROSS-TRADITION rows, not merged; this is the third tradition in the programme needing that note (after Danel/Paghat and Olokun/Eshu), which argues for a deliberate tradition-key review rather than more case-by-case flags. TWO DELIBERATE NON-ADDITIONS: the Tonsured Maize God is identified by the treatments with Hun Hunahpu, already present, and Chac Chel is already an alias on maya_ix_chel; both are ALIAS rows rather than the duplicate this programme forbids. LETTER-LABEL RULE: where a Schellhas or Palenque label has been resolved to a name the name is primary and the label an alias (K'awiil/God K/GII, Pauahtun/God N); where it has not -- God L, GI, GIII -- the label IS the record's name, because inventing a reading would be worse. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: GII's Palenque birth date (28 vs 6 November 2360 BC); Tecun Uman's death (12 vs 20 February 1524); Itzamnaaj Bahlam's numbering at Yaxchilan (II vs III); Kan Ek's death (execution vs disease). 10 REJECT are collectives and offices (the four hundred boys, the Xibalbans, the Bacabs as a class, the four Chaacs, Ah Kin, Halach Uinic, Nacom, the wayob) -- the four named Bacabs are ingested individually and the class is not. 25 BLOCKED in three kinds: list-only deities (Acat, Kinich Kakmo, Ah Peku, Ah Tabai, Ah Kin Xoc, Ix Chup) under the same caution the Aztec pass applied to the Mexica lists; ambiguous referents (Ix Chebel Yax may or may not be Ix Chel; Itzam Cab Ain may or may not be Itzamna; Nim Ac and Nima Tziis may be epithets of two records already held); and named-but-empty figures who appear in this batch's own records as somebody's parent or antagonist with nothing else retrievable -- Spearthrower Owl is the one worth escalating, as he is the Teotihuacan figure behind the 378 entrada and may belong to a Teotihuacan lane. Two further blocks are scoping: the remaining Tikal and Copan king-lists, and the 1847 Caste War leaders. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-10/maya-census.tsv and maya-audit.md.

First Chinese pass. 48 -> 98 records. A 72-name check across the WHOLE registry returned TWO hits and BOTH ARE FALSE -- 'Yanluo Wang' matched buddhist_yama and hindu_yama, figures at the other end of a transmission rather than the Chinese magistrate, and 'Tudigong' matched baule_asie, an unrelated West African earth deity, on a normalised alias. Seventy absences out of seventy-two, the worst hit rate this programme has recorded, in the religious corpus with more adherents and more surviving text than any other in the registry. ABSENT: all three of the Three Pure Ones, who are the highest deities in Daoism, in a corpus holding the Jade Emperor who is below them; SIX OF THE EIGHT IMMORTALS (the registry held Lu Dongbin and He Xiangu, and the Eight are a set that is painted, carved and invoked together); the ENTIRE underworld -- no Yanluo Wang, no Meng Po whose soup of forgetting every Chinese soul drinks, no Zhong Kui, no Ox-Head and Horse-Face, no Black and White Impermanence; the casts of BOTH novels the popular pantheon comes from (Sun Wukong without the pilgrimage, and Li Jing/Nezha/Jinzha/Muzha of the Fengshen Yanyi without Jiang Ziya, who holds the roster by which every god in that book is appointed); Chiyou, Xingtian, Kuafu and Jingwei, the four most-quoted figures in early Chinese myth after the sovereigns the registry did hold; the Four Perils; and Guan Yu and Mazu, who between them have more temples than any other two figures in the Chinese world. 50 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/chinese-expansion.txt. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. PATTERNS REPEATED FROM EARLIER LANES: the famous name without the thing it is defined against, now for the fifth tradition -- Huangdi without Chiyou, Houyi without Xihe whose suns he shot, Shennong without Jingwei his daughter, Guanyin without Red Boy whom she took, Chang'e without Zhu Bajie who was banished for propositioning her; and the group held as a fraction -- two of eight Immortals, three of five Four-Clans culture heroes, one of four Dragon Kings, one of ten Kings of Hell. TWO SCOPING DECISIONS: Chenghuang the City God and Tudigong the Earth God are REJECTED as classes, because the reference treatments define them as the tutelary deity of a particular town or field, multiplied indefinitely -- the same rule that turned away the Ajogun, the Bacabs-as-a-class and the Are Ona Kakanfo, and the census says they are the first ADDs if the owner wants office-deities. The imperial line, two thousand years of emperors absent entirely, is deferred AS A UNIT rather than sampled. DISCLOSURES: fifteen of the fifty come from two sixteenth-century novels and every such record says so on its face rather than presenting a Ming invention as ancient myth. Laozi is an ALIAS on Daode Tianzun and not a record, because the tradition treats the philosopher as a descent of the deity and not the reverse; no position is taken on his historicity. Yanluo Wang is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_yama and NOT merged. NO relation is written between Xihe and Houyi despite his shooting nine of her ten children, because the tradition states none and inventing an enmity would be worse than recording the absence. 11 REJECT are classes and offices. 5 CROSS-TRADITION rows cover the Yama transmission, the false Tudigong/baule_asie match (recorded so the 2-of-72 hit rate is not misread), and Chiyou's claim by the Miao and Hmong, of whom the corpus holds ten records. 15 BLOCKED: named-and-not-retrieved (Taiyi Jiuku Tianzun, Houtu, Yuelao, Changxi, Longmu, Huang Feihu and the Fengshen middle cast); reciprocals this batch's own records cannot carry (Di Jun for Xihe, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei for Guan Yu, the other three Dragon Kings, the other eight Kings of Hell); and not-searched-and-named-as-such. CONFUCIUS is the notable block -- he has had state temples for two thousand years and is a cult figure on this registry's own terms, and he is absent only because he was not researched in this session and writing him from recall is what this programme does not do. He is a strong ADD for the next pass. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-11/chinese-census.tsv and chinese-audit.md.

First Japanese pass. 48 -> 95 records. A 61-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 10 hits and 51 absences, six of the ten being deliberate controls and two of the remaining four FALSE POSITIVES: 'Takemikazuchi' matched japanese_kojiki_takemikazuchi_miwa, who is a human scion of the Miwa line and not the thunder kami of Kashima (the new record is given a distinguishing id), and 'Bishamonten'/'Emma' matched buddhist_vaishravana and buddhist_yama, the Indian ends of two transmissions. THE BASELINE OF 48 WAS MISLEADING: roughly twenty of the 48 are a single late-Heian Minamoto genealogy (Yoshiie through Yoritomo and Yoshitsune) and another seven a Kojiki mythohistorical sub-branch around the Miwa line, so the kami pantheon proper was about twenty records. What it was missing was structure rather than ornament. ABSENT: all five Kotoamatsukami, including Ame-no-Minakanushi, who is the first being in the Kojiki and therefore the first sentence of Japanese literature; the whole rock-cave cast except the goddess who hid and the goddess who danced -- no Omoikane whose plan it was, no Ame-no-Tajikarao who opened the door, no Ishikoridome who made the mirror, no Tamanooya who strung the jewels, no Ame-no-Koyane and Futodama who did the divination and are the ancestral deities of the two clans that ran Japanese court ritual for a thousand years; Yamata-no-Orochi and Kushinada-hime and her parents, in a corpus holding Susanoo; BOTH ENVOYS AND BOTH SONS of the kuni-yuzuri, so the transaction the imperial house's legitimacy rests on had one party present; the entire Hyuga cycle between Ninigi and Jimmu, so the descent from Amaterasu broke off two generations short of arriving; Jimmu, Yamato Takeru and Empress Jingu; five of the Seven Lucky Gods; and Tenjin, the most widely worshipped deified human in Japan. 47 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/japanese-expansion.txt. ONE PRE-EXISTING RECORD MODIFIED: japanese_konohanasakuya_hime gains the reciprocal sibling edge to the new Iwanaga-hime, because the two sisters are defined entirely against each other -- blossom and rock -- and the Kojiki's point is that sending the rock back traded the imperial line's immortality for its looks. 13 inserted lines in data-sources/transcripts/a577b80600b7956a8.txt and nothing else touched. DELIBERATE NON-ACTIONS: yokai are not ingested as classes (tengu, kappa, kitsune, oni, tanuki are REJECT rows; the three NAMED yokai -- Shuten-doji, Tamamo-no-Mae, Yamata-no-Orochi -- are records). Ojin is NOT added, because he is deified as Hachiman, whom the registry holds and whose own record derives the name from the eight banners at Ojin's birth; Jingu's mother-of edge points at the Hachiman record. Bishamonten is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_vaishravana and not merged. THE BUDDHIST/JAPANESE KEY SPLIT IS NOT RESOLVED and is escalated: Kannon, Jizo, Amida, Fudo Myoo and Emma are BLOCKED on it, not on evidence. This is the FIFTH LANE RUNNING to raise a tradition-key question (Canaanite, Yoruba, Maya, Chinese, Japanese), which is a pattern rather than five coincidences and argues for a deliberate review. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: the first kami (Ame-no-Minakanushi in the Kojiki, Kuninotokotachi in the Nihon Shoki -- a live political question for a thousand years, and both are records); who killed the food goddess (Susanoo in the Kojiki, Tsukuyomi in the Nihon Shoki, where the murder is why sun and moon are never in the sky together); who exposed Tamamo-no-Mae (Seimei or his successor Yasunari); and Jimmu's historicity (660 BC per the chronicles, no evidence per the historians). 11 REJECT are kinds, categories, places and objects. 13 BLOCKED, of which two are worth escalating: SUKUNABIKONA, one of the best-known figures in the Izumo material, whose neighbours the same search returned and who it did not; and EMPEROR SUTOKU, the third of the three greatest yokai, which this batch therefore holds as two of three -- the exact fault it has spent five traditions objecting to. Both are strong ADDs for a second pass. The Kintaro identification with Sakata no Kintoki is standard in Japan, was not returned by the sources consulted, and is blocked rather than asserted. 4 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-12/japanese-census.tsv and japanese-audit.md.

First Norse pass. 67 -> 101 records. A 51-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 11 hits and 40 absences; eight of the eleven were deliberate controls and the other three are FALSE -- 'Sol' matched roman_sol, 'Mani' matched nuer_mani, 'Nerthus' matched continental_germanic_nerthus. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE, and the eighth tradition running to show it: THE REGISTRY HELD SIGURD AND NOT THE DRAGON. No Fafnir. No Regin, who forged the sword and set him on; no Otr, whose skin fixed the price; no Hreidmarr, who demanded it; no Andvari, whose ring carries the curse. The corpus already held the ENTIRE Volsung cycle -- Sigurd, Brynhildr, Gudrun, Sigmund, Signy, Sinfjotli, Svanhild, Jormunrekkr and a dozen more, all of whom die because of a bag of gold paid for an otter -- and it did not hold the gold, the otter or the dragon. NOT ASSERTED: no relation between Gullveig and Freyja, no identification of Lodurr with Loki, and no explanation of why Utgarda-Loki shares a name with Loki -- all three are scholarly proposals and this programme does not write edges on proposals. 10 REJECT are categories, collectives, a tree, and four named horses identified only by a name and an owner (Sleipnir is ingested because the sources give him a parent and a biography). 11 BLOCKED, of which FOUR are strong ADDs held only for want of a retrievable citation and are flagged upward: GARMR, the hound at Gnipahellir; VAFTHRUDNIR, who contests wisdom with Odin over a whole Eddic poem; ASK AND EMBLA, the first humans; and GYLFI, who is both the king in the Gefjon story and the frame narrator of the Gylfaginning. Each was searched alongside figures that did come back. ONE CORRECTION THE TEST SUITE FORCED: Skoll and Hati were first written at era 'primordial', on the reasoning that the sun and moon they chase are primordial; npm test rejected it, because both have parentIds [norse_fenrir] and Fenrir is filed at mythic-prehistoric, and a parent cannot be later than a child. First Slavic pass. 18 -> 41 records; Slavic was the SMALLEST holding of any tradition in this corpus with a literature. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE: THE REGISTRY HELD FIVE OF THE SIX IDOLS OF KIEV. The Primary Chronicle's entry for 980 names Perun, Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh -- the only place an East Slavic ruler's own pantheon is enumerated -- and the registry held all of them except KHORS, who is the most frequently mentioned Slavic god after Perun. Five-of-six is worse than none, because a corpus with a hole in the middle of its only enumerated pantheon looks complete. METHODOLOGICAL FINDING, PROPOSED AS STANDARD FOR EVERY REMAINING LANE: the lane opened with a 48-name sweep (19 hits, 29 absences, every hit a deliberate control) which produced the first 19 records; the sweep was then RE-RUN, widened to 92 names, AFTER those records were in the corpus, and returned Khors, Yarovit, Prove and Podaga -- all absent, all chronicle-attested. A sweep tests the registry against the author's recall, so the names checked first are the names that came to mind first; re-running it once the obvious names are satisfied surfaces what the first pass crowded out. Block VI of the transcript is the argument. ALSO ABSENT: the RUGEN TEMPLES -- Svetovid of Arkona (four heads, a horn read for the harvest, a temple Saxo described and the Danes destroyed in 1168), Rugievit, Porevit and Porenut. These are the BEST-ATTESTED Slavic deities there are, because a hostile eyewitness wrote down what the statues looked like before knocking them over, and the registry instead held the reconstructed abstractions Belobog, Chernobog, Rod and Lada. Three more chronicle-attested West Slavic gods: Yarovit, whose Wolgast temple held a giant shield instead of a statue and was destroyed in 1128, and Prove and Podaga, Helmold's two Wagrian gods -- one an oak grove with no image, the other an image with no grove. THE SEASONAL CYCLE: the registry held Marzanna, who is winter and death, and nothing she acts on -- not Jarilo, whom she marries and murders every year; not Ziva; not Kupala. THE FOLKLORE: no Baba Yaga, no Koschei, and no ZMEY GORYNYCH in a registry holding DOBRYNYA NIKITICH, whose one defining deed is killing that dragon -- the ninth tradition running to show that exact fault. THE BYLINA CAST: the three bogatyrs were joined to each other and to nothing else, with no court to serve at, no opponent, and neither Svyatogor nor Mikula Selyaninovich, the two figures the epic treats as stronger than all three. THE BIRD-MAIDENS: Alkonost, Sirin, Gamayun. 23 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/slavic-expansion.txt. ZERO pre-existing records mutated: every symmetric relation is reciprocated inside the batch and every edge toward a pre-existing record uses a non-symmetric kind, chosen because it is also truer -- Jarilo consort-of and killed-by Marzanna (a marriage that lasts one season and ends in a murder), Zmey Gorynych slain-by Dobrynya, Solovei defeated-by Ilya, Vladimir overlord-of each of the three bogatyrs, Khors co-enshrined-with each of the other five Kiev idols (a joint erection in 980, not kinship or alliance), Prove and Podaga named-alongside (a textual relation, labelled as one). SCOPE DECISIONS TAKEN EXPLICITLY: household and landscape spirits are CLASSES and are REJECT rows (domovoi, rusalka, leshy, vodyanoy, bannik, kikimora, vila, poludnitsa, chort, likho, upyr, bereginya, rozhanitsy) -- there is a domovoi behind every stove, not one Domovoi; the three BIRD-MAIDENS are not classes and go in as three records. LEL AND POLEL ARE REJECTED WHERE DEVANA IS INGESTED, and the distinction is argued: both come from Dlugosz, but dziewanna is an independent Polish plant-name with a life outside him and lelum polelum is a burden in a song. VESNA is not ingested and is NOT made an alias of Ziva -- that equation is modern and neither source makes it. The Firebird is an ITEMS question; Sivka-Burka is a named horse identified only by a name and an owner, the exact ground on which four Norse horses were rejected in lane 13. WEIGHT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: Jarilo medium (no medieval text tells the story; it is Katicic and Belaj's twentieth-century reconstruction from spring songs), Kupala medium (the festival is old and pagan, the god is probably a back-formation from its name), Podaga medium, DEVANA LOW (Dlugosz supplies a Slavic Jupiter, Ceres, Pluto and Diana, in order, which is not how pantheons are found). NOT ASSERTED: no edge between Yarovit and Jarilo despite the shared jar- root, because that is a scholarly proposal; no edge between Baba Yaga and Koschei, because sharing a tale is not a relation; no sun-or-moon ruling on Khors; no identification of the epic Vladimir with Vladimir Svyatoslavich, and no dates on him; no Volkhova or Lyubava on Sadko, because both are Rimsky-Korsakov's 1898 opera and not the bylina; no sphere for Prove beyond his cult and no domains at all for Podaga. 16 BLOCKED, of which FOUR are strong ADDs flagged upward: KIY, SHCHEK, KHORIV AND LYBID, the legendary founders of Kiev, from the same source this batch used for Khors; VOLGA SVYATOSLAVICH, Mikula's usual companion, so the batch ingests Mikula without his pair; MAT SYRA ZEMLYA, Moist Mother Earth, whom both the Svyatogor and Mikula records turn on; and TURUPIT, PURUVIT AND KAREVIT of the Knytlinga saga, which would complete a Rugen set this batch holds four of. RADEGAST IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF BLOCKER AND THE MOST INTERESTING ROW IN THE CENSUS: Helmold places him at Rethra and Thietmar places Zuarasici -- Svarozhich, ALREADY IN THE CORPUS -- at the same sanctuary, and the two are widely identified, so ingesting Radegast could duplicate an existing record under a second name. Blocked until a treatment rules on it. Marya Morevna, Vasilisa and Ivan Tsarevich are blocked on a SCOPE question rather than on evidence -- whether a tale-type role filled by a differently-named character in each variant is an individual for this registry -- which also gates Koschei's relations. 7 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. FOR THE NEXT PASS: the era vocabulary invites historical rulers (kievan-rus-historical is registered and holds nothing but the epic Vladimir added here), and the Baltic keys hold the cognate figures at small counts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-14/slavic-census.tsv and slavic-audit.md.

First Zoroastrian pass. 33 -> 70 records. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE: THE REGISTRY DID NOT HOLD ZARATHUSTRA. A 95-name check returned 13 hits and 82 absences; six of the thirteen were aliases already carried on existing records (Jamshid on Yima, Zahhak on Azhi Dahaka, Fereydun on Thraetaona, Garshasp on Keresaspa, Bahman on Vohu Manah, Anahita on Aredvi Sura Anahita) and two were FALSE ('Indra' matched the Hindu god rather than the Zoroastrian arch-daeva of the same name; 'Vata' matched hindu_vayu). The corpus held Ahura Mazda, Angra Mainyu, all six Amesha Spentas, nine yazatas and fifteen figures of the Iranian legendary cycle, and not the prophet the religion is named after -- nor ANY of the handful of human beings the Gathas name: not Vishtaspa his patron, not Jamasp, not Frashaoshtra, not his daughter Pouruchista. FOUR MORE STRUCTURAL HOLES OF THE SAME SHAPE. (1) ALL SIX AMESHA SPENTAS WERE PRESENT AND ALL SIX OF THEIR OPPONENTS WERE ABSENT: the Vendidad sets Aka Manah against Vohu Manah, Indra against Asha Vahishta, Saurva against Khshathra Vairya, Nanghaithya against Spenta Armaiti, Taurvi against Haurvatat, Zairich against Ameretat -- six for six, which in a dualist religion is half the system. (2) TISHTRYA WAS HELD WITH AN EMPTY RELATIONS ARRAY and his entire myth is a horse-fight with APAOSHA for the waters of Vourukasha: the registry held a fight with one fighter in it, which is the cleanest instance yet of the pattern this programme has found in ten traditions. (3) NO CREATION ACCOUNT AT ALL -- no Gayomart the first man, no Mashya and Mashyana, no Gavaevodata the sole-created ox. (4) NO ESCHATOLOGY -- no Saoshyant, no Hushedar, no Hushedar-mah, in the religion most often credited with introducing a world with a datable end. A NEW VARIETY OF THE RECURRING FAULT: THE CORPUS HELD THE BORROWER AND NOT THE LENDER. Aeshma, the demon of wrath, was absent while jewish_ashmedai -- Asmodeus, the figure Aeshma is generally taken to stand behind -- was already held. Every previous instance of this finding has been a gap within one tradition; this one runs across two. No equated-with edge is drawn, because the treatment describes a likely derivation rather than an identity and the kind is symmetric. THE SHAHNAMEH WAS HELD FROM THE MIDDLE. ZAL WAS HELD WITH AN EMPTY parentIds ARRAY and his son Rostam with both parents named, so two generations above Rostam the genealogy simply stopped in a corpus whose whole subject is descent; this batch adds Sam, who abandoned Zal in the Alborz for being born white-haired, Nariman his father, and the Simurgh, who found the child and raised him. AFRASIAB, king of Turan and chief antagonist of the entire epic and already in the Avesta as Frangrasyan, was absent in a corpus holding five figures whose stories are all about him. Tahmineh, Sohrab's mother, was absent. Salm, Tur and Iraj were absent, so the quarrel that makes Iran and Turan enemies had no parties in it. Kaveh the blacksmith was absent -- the one commoner in a cycle the registry held only the kings and heroes of. METHOD: THE SWEEP WAS RUN TWICE, as lane 14 proposed as standard. First sweep 95 names, 13 hits, 82 absences. Second sweep 168 names, run AFTER the 37 records were generated: 95 hits, 73 absences, all 37 new records resolving. Honest report: in lane 14 the re-run found four ingestible figures; here it found a better BLOCKED list (Pourushaspa and Dughdova, Hvovi, Hutaosa, Vivanghant, Hushang and Tahmuras). Both are worth the cost. ZERO pre-existing records mutated; every edge toward a pre-existing record uses a non-symmetric kind. Six arch-daevas 'opposes' their six Amesha Spentas; Apaosha defeated-by Tishtrya (direction matters, because Apaosha wins the first round); Gayomart slain-by Angra Mainyu; Daena presents-the-soul-before Mithra, Sraosha and Rashnu, completing a Chinvat tribunal the corpus held three quarters of; Sam father-of Zal AND, as a separate edge, Sam abandoned Zal, because the abandonment is not an incident of the fatherhood but the event the whole Sistan cycle proceeds from; Simurgh foster-parent-of Zal; Tahmineh mother-of Sohrab; Afrasiab manipulated Sohrab; Kaveh rebelled-against Azhi Dahaka; Zurvan progenitor-of-in-zurvanite-doctrine Ahura Mazda and Angra Mainyu, a kind that names the doctrine inside itself because the claim is true only within it, with nothing entered in anyone's parentIds; Tur ancestor-of Afrasiab rather than father-of, because one treatment makes Tur his father directly and the Shahnameh puts Pashang between them. CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: the lists of the six arch-daevas DO NOT AGREE -- one substitutes Nasu for Aka Manah -- so Nasu is ingested on his own footing with NO opposes edge, because drawing one would mean picking his slot; Gayomart is the first man in the Bundahishn and the first king in the epic, and both are on the record; Afrasiab's genealogy as above. NOT ASSERTED: no date for Zarathustra, because the question spans roughly a thousand years of serious proposals and any date would pick a side; no identification of Vishtaspa with Hystaspes the father of Darius, which is a pivot of that same dating question; no sibling edge between Jamasp and Frashaoshtra, because the source says clan and not brothers; no cross-tradition edge from the daeva Indra to hindu_indra or from Nanghaithya to the Ashvins, because three of the six arch-daevas carrying Vedic god-names is a fact about two traditions and not a relation between two individuals; no sibling edges among the three saviours, who share a father and a lake and are two thousand years apart. TRADITION-KEY QUESTION RAISED FOR THE SEVENTH LANE RUNNING: the corpus holds sogdian_zurvan and this batch adds zoroastrian_zurvan WITHOUT MERGING, on the precedent the corpus itself sets by holding zoroastrian_mithra and roman_mithraic_mysteries_mithras separately. Merging is destructive and irreversible and is the owner's call. TWO ANIMALS INGESTED AND ONE REJECTED ON A STATED RULE: Gavaevodata and the Simurgh go in; RAKHSH, Rostam's horse, is a REJECT row on exactly the ground that rejected four Norse horses in lane 13 and Sivka-Burka in lane 14 -- identified only by a name and an owner. The ox is a singular created being with a cosmogonic role and its own death; the Simurgh has a will, a moral decision and a household. 20 BLOCKED, of which SEVEN are strong ADDs, and the first two are this lane's own fault one generation up: POURUSHASPA AND DUGHDOVA, the prophet's own parents, added-without; HVOVI, his wife and in the tradition the daughter of Frashaoshtra, who IS ingested here; VIVANGHANT, Yima's father, in a corpus holding Yima with no parents; HUSHANG AND TAHMURAS, so the corpus holds the third king of a dynasty and not the first two; MANUCHEHR, who avenges Iraj, so the batch adds the crime and not the reckoning; ESFANDIYAR, searched twice without a retrievable treatment; and HVARE-KHSHAETA AND MAH, the sun and the moon, in a corpus that now holds Tishtrya and Apaosha. TWO BLOCKERS ARE SCHEMA QUESTIONS RATHER THAN RESEARCH QUESTIONS AND ARE ESCALATED: the tradition's registered era vocabulary is 'primordial | legendary' and NOTHING ELSE, so Kartir, Adurbad, Tansar, Mazdak and the ENTIRE SASANIAN HALF OF THE SHAHNAMEH -- Ardashir, Bahram Gur, Khosrow Parviz, Shirin, Bahram Chobin -- have no era to be filed in. Compare lane 14, where the Slavic vocabulary registers kievan-rus-historical and holds almost nothing in it. Both are one decision for the owner and it gates more candidates than any citation gap in this census. ONE FURTHER OBSERVATION: the registry's Iranian holdings are overwhelmingly male, and Bizhan and Manizheh, Sudabeh and Gordafarid are where that would begin to change. 4 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts; two others that would have been kinless were given properly cited edges instead. PARTIAL. The obvious next pass is Yasht-by-Yasht. See audits/lane-15/zoroastrian-census.tsv and zoroastrian-audit.md.

First Hindu pass, taking the CONFLICTS. 133 -> 177 records. THE HEADLINE: THE REGISTRY HELD THE PANDAVAS AND NOT THE KAURAVAS. A 138-name check returned 17 hits and 121 absences; SIX of the seventeen hits are FALSE -- 'Uttara' matched mon_uttara, 'Kurma' matched fur_kuruma, 'Sati' matched egyptian_satis, 'Mangala' matched mandinka_maa_ngala, 'Ila' matched koryak_illa, and 'Bali' matched hindu_vali, the VANARA king of the Ramayana rather than the asura king of the Vamana story. The 133 records were not thinly spread -- the corpus holds FIVE SONS OF KARNA -- but it held no other side of anything. All five Pandavas, Draupadi, Kunti, Madri, Pandu, Dhritarashtra, Bhishma, Vyasa, Drupada, Dhrishtadyumna, Abhimanyu and Karna were there. NOT ONE KAURAVA. No Duryodhana, no Gandhari, no Dushasana, no Shakuni, no Vikarna -- and none of the men the war is fought by on that side: no Drona, who taught BOTH houses, no Kripa, no Ashwatthama, no Kritavarma, no Jayadratha. The Mahabharata is a war between two families and the registry held one of them. THE SAME FAULT FOUR MORE TIMES, IN THE GOD-AND-ADVERSARY PAIRS: Indra without VRITRA, whose killing gives Indra his standing Rigvedic epithet Vritrahan; Durga without MAHISHASURA, whose killing gives her her commonest cult name Mahishasuramardini; Narasimha without HIRANYAKASHIPU, in an avatar that exists for that one killing and no other; Varaha without HIRANYAKSHA, likewise. TWO OF THOSE GODS ARE NAMED AFTER THE BEING THEY KILL and the registry held the name and not the being. Also absent: PRAHLADA, the boy the Narasimha avatar comes to save. DITI states it most precisely -- the corpus held Kashyapa and held ADITI, mother of the gods, and not Diti, mother of their opponents by the same father. The registry's Hindu holdings were a family tree with the losing side pruned. DASHARATHA HAD THREE QUEENS AND THE CORPUS HELD TWO: Kausalya and Sumitra, the two whose sons it ALREADY HELD, and not KAIKEYI, whose two boons exile Rama for fourteen years, which is the event the Ramayana consists of. That is lane 14's five-of-six pattern with a MECHANISM rather than bad luck: a corpus that adds people because other people it holds are related to them reaches a queen through her son and stops where no son is held. The rest of the Ramayana's missing half follows: Manthara, Mandodari, Shurpanakha, Maricha, Tataka, Ahalya -- and VALMIKI, who wrote the poem, in a corpus holding twenty-odd of its characters AND holding Vyasa, the other epic's author, with his parents and his sons. THE TWO HOUSES HAD NO COMMON ANCESTOR. The corpus held the Kurus back to Pratipa and the Yadavas back to Shura and nothing above either, so the two families the epic is about had no reason in the data to be related. They descend from YAYATI by two wives: Devayani's son YADU founds the Yadavas and Sharmishtha's son PURU founds the line that becomes the Kurus. Seven records and they are cousins in the data rather than only in the story. METHOD, SWEEP RUN TWICE: first 138 names, 17 hits, 121 absences; second 242 names after generation, 99 hits, 143 absences, all 44 new records resolving. The second sweep produced the strongest blocked rows -- KURU himself, eponym of the Kauravas and of Kurukshetra; SHAKUNTALA, DUSHYANTA and the Bharata the COUNTRY is named after, where the corpus holds a DIFFERENT Bharata; DUSHALA, the Kauravas' one daughter and Jayadratha's wife; and the whole SOLAR DYNASTY, so the corpus cannot say that Rama is an Ikshvaku. ZERO pre-existing records mutated; every edge toward an existing record is non-symmetric. Kaikeyi exiled Rama is one edge and it is the Ramayana. Gandhari intervened-for Draupadi: the two women stand on opposite sides of the hall in the epic's worst scene and the one who stops it is the mother of the men who caused it. Duryodhana befriended-by Karna: the corpus held Karna and five of his sons and not the man whose friendship explains his position. Kaikeyi mother-of Bharata as a RELATION, because the corpus holds Bharata with parentIds naming Dasharatha alone -- exactly the asymmetry lane 15 found with Sohrab. TWO CORRECTIONS THE TEST SUITE FORCED. (1) ASHWATTHAMA'S TYPE: authored demigod on the sources making him a combined incarnation of Shiva, Yama, Kama and Krodha; npm test rejected it as tier-classification drift, because this corpus computes the tier from DESCENT and both his parents are mortals. Corrected to mortal; the incarnation claim stays in the lifecycle. (2) THE DETAIL-SHARD SIZE TRIPWIRE FIRED AND THE PRE-AGREED RESPONSE EXECUTED: test/scale-gates.test.cjs budgets each lazily-fetched detail shard at 150KB gz and at 6,362 figures bucket 8 reached 151KB. The documented response for that tripwire is 'BUCKETS steps up via the deterministic formula', so bucketCountFor() in scripts/build-tiers.cjs had its per-shard target moved from 100 to 80, taking the corpus from 64 shards to 128. THIS IS A CORRECTION TO THE FORMULA'S OWN ASSUMPTION, NOT A BUMP TO GREEN A BUILD: the formula's comment claimed 100 records a shard would fit the budget and real data falsified it, because the hash does not distribute evenly -- average 99.4 a shard while the largest was over. After the step-up the largest shard is 79.9KB and the median 56.4KB, and the documented 30k -> 512 anchor is unchanged. test/tiers.test.cjs mirrors the same constant and was updated with it; NO test was skipped, disabled or quarantined, and the assertion still requires the bucket count to follow the formula exactly. LOAD-TIME INVARIANTS RE-CHECKED: shards are fetched lazily per figure-open so more of them means FEWER bytes per open and nothing added to first load; dist/site/index.html is 40.4KB gz and its app-<hash>.js is still deferred. RESTRAINT MADE VISIBLE: the BLINDFOLD IS NOT ON GANDHARI'S RECORD, because it is not in the treatments consulted; Dushasana's record does not narrate the disrobing; Vikarna's does not say he objected to it; Shishupala's does not give the hundred offences or the beheading; Ahalya's curse is recorded as 'a curse' and not as the turning-to-stone, because the versions differ and whether she was complicit is what the tradition argues about for two thousand years. Puru and Yadu are 'sibling' and not 'half sibling' because the treatment states the shared father without using either term, and parentRoles carry the actual mothers. TWO WITHIN-TRADITION ID COLLISIONS, both handled with qualified ids rather than silent merges: hindu_chitrasena_kaurava, because hindu_chitrasena_karna already exists; and hindu_mahabali, because hindu_vali is the vanara king. Both are WITHIN one tradition, not across two, which is new. 20 BLOCKED. Strong ADDs in order of how badly they are missed: KURU himself; SHAKUNTALA, DUSHYANTA and BHARATA; SATI, DAKSHA and ANDHAKA, so a corpus holding Shiva and Parvati has something of the cycle connecting them; THE NAVAGRAHA, of which the corpus holds none as grahas and which are the most widely worshipped set of figures in living practice; THE SOLAR DYNASTY; and EKALAVYA. ESCALATED AND NOT A FIGURE: the corpus files hindu_dhritarashtra at era 'epic-period' and his nephews the Pandavas at 'dvapara-yuga', which is EARLIER in the registered Hindu era order, so the Kauravas added here are filed at epic-period to match their father and FIRST COUSINS NOW SIT IN TWO DIFFERENT ERAS. This batch declines to fix a pre-existing inconsistency by mutating records it did not author; it will recur in every future Mahabharata pass. Zero kinless figures - every one of the 44 carries an edge. PARTIAL. Hindu is still the largest absolute gap in this corpus at 177 records. See audits/lane-16/hindu-census.tsv and hindu-audit.md.

Second Hindu pass, working the list lane 16's audit named. 177 -> 208 records. THE CORPUS HELD NONE OF THE NINE GRAHAS AS GRAHAS. The Navagraha are the most widely worshipped set of figures in living Hindu practice - a Navagraha shrine stands in most substantial temples in southern India - and the corpus held Surya and Soma for other reasons and lane 16 added Shukra for his part in two stories. Mangala, Budha, Brihaspati, Shani, Rahu and Ketu were absent. WITH THIS BATCH THE CORPUS HOLDS ALL NINE INDIVIDUALLY. RAHU AND KETU ARE ONE BEING CUT IN HALF: the asura Svarbhanu drank the nectar in disguise, Vishnu took his head off with the discus before it could pass his throat, and because the nectar had already reached him BOTH HALVES ARE IMMORTAL - the head is Rahu, the body is Ketu, and the eclipse is the head swallowing the sun. The corpus held the sun, the moon and the discus and neither half of the thing that eats them. The registry has no vocabulary for that relation, because nothing else in the corpus is two records that were one body; the kind 'severed-half-of' is invented for it. The tradition assigns the two halves OPPOSITE DISPOSITIONS - the head grasping at the world, the body turned away - and that is on both records rather than summarised on one. THE CHURNING OF THE OCEAN, OF WHICH THE CORPUS HELD NO PART: not KURMA the tortoise who holds the mountain up, not VASUKI the naga used as the rope, not DHANVANTARI who rises with the pot and is the patron deity of Ayurveda, not MOHINI, the form Vishnu takes to get the nectar back and therefore the direct cause of Rahu's beheading - so two records in this batch describe the same minute from two sides. KURMA WAS A BLOCKED ROW IN LANE 16, held for want of a treatment that gave him an act rather than a place in a list; this pass retrieved one. FIRST TIME IN THIS PROGRAMME THAT A BLOCKED ROW FROM ONE LANE HAS BEEN CLEARED BY THE NEXT, which is the argument for keeping blocked rows rather than rejecting them. TWO HOUSEHOLDS FINISHED, on the pattern lane 16 named - the corpus holds the god and not the household. SURYA HAD TWO WIVES AND THE CORPUS HELD NEITHER: Sanjna, who could not bear his heat, and CHHAYA, the shadow she left in her place, who is Shani's mother - a cast shadow with a household, children and a will of her own, whom the tradition treats as a person throughout. SOMA HAD A WIFE AND THE CORPUS HELD NEITHER HER NOR THE SON: Tara, taken from Brihaspati, returned pregnant, mother of Budha. THE DAKSHA CYCLE: the corpus holds Shiva and Parvati and held nothing of what stands between them - Daksha, who holds a sacrifice and does not invite his daughter's husband; Sati, who burns herself in the fire of it; and Virabhadra, whom Shiva tears out of his own hair to go and behead him. NO EDGE IS DRAWN FROM SATI TO PARVATI: that Parvati is Sati reborn is a claim about identity across lives, this registry has no kind for it, and inventing one would commit the corpus to a position on rebirth that would then apply to the avatars, the jatakas and every tradition with reincarnation in it. No cross-tradition edge is drawn, on the rule applied since lane 13 - a shared etymology is a fact about traditions and not a relation between beings - and the same restraint covers Mitra beside zoroastrian_mithra, Bhaga beside the Slavic bog- in four theonyms lane 14 touched, and Parjanya beside Perun and Perkunas. First Irish pass. 43 -> 71 records. THE HEADLINE: THE REGISTRY HAD AN ERA REGISTERED FOR THE FENIAN CYCLE AND NOT ONE FIGURE IN IT. 'fenian-cycle' is the sixth era in the Irish vocabulary and NOTHING was filed there. The Fenian or Fianna Cycle is one of the four great cycles of Irish literature and the one that survived longest in living oral tradition on both sides of the Irish Sea, and the corpus held no Fionn mac Cumhaill, no Oisin, no Oscar, no Diarmuid, no Grainne, no Caoilte, no Niamh, no Sadhbh. AN EMPTY REGISTERED ERA IS THE CLEAREST STATEMENT A CORPUS CAN MAKE ABOUT WHAT IT IS MISSING, and this programme has now found two of them - lane 15 found the Zoroastrian vocabulary registering nothing between primordial and legendary for a tradition with a Sasanian history, and this one found an era with a name, a position in the order and nobody in it. The fenian-cycle era now holds 13 records; 'early-christian', which also held nothing, now holds Saint Patrick. The census flags 'cycles-of-kings' as the next of these, holding three records for a cycle with a king-list. An 81-name check returned 10 hits and 71 absences. THE TAIN IS A STORY ABOUT A BULL AND THE CORPUS DID NOT HOLD THE BULL. It held Medb, Ailill, Cu Chulainn, Fergus, Ferdiad and Findabair - everyone who fights over DONN CUAILNGE, the Brown Bull of Cooley - and neither him nor FINNBHENNACH, the white-horned bull of Connacht. Medb and Ailill's pillow talk is about whose wealth is greater; Ailill has the white bull; Medb has nothing to match it because the only bull of that caliber is in Ulster; she raises an army. At the end the two bulls fight across the whole of Ireland in a battle that reshapes the landscape, the Brown Bull kills the white one and then dies of its wounds. THESE TWO ARE INGESTED WHERE FIVE NAMED HORSES WERE REJECTED in lanes 13, 14, 15 and 17, and on the ground those rejections stated: the horses were identified by a name and an owner, and these two have a quarrel of their own, fight it out, change the map doing it and kill each other. THE TWO TRIOS THE CORPUS HELD ONE THIRD OF. Ernmas, whom the corpus holds, is the mother of two trinities: the eponymous goddesses Eriu, Banba and Fodla, and the war goddesses Badb, Macha and the Morrigan. THE CORPUS HELD THE MOTHER AND ONE DAUGHTER FROM EACH - and the mechanism is lane 16's: Eriu is the one modern Eire is named after and the Morrigan is the famous one, so a registry that grows by adding the name people know produces exactly this shape, twice, in one tradition. MACHA IS THE ONE THAT COSTS THE MOST: her curse is why the men of Ulster lie helpless through the Tain and why Cu Chulainn fights the whole war alone, and that is a BLOCKED row for want of a citation - the corpus holds the consequence and not the cause, again. ALSO ABSENT: DEIRDRE, in a corpus holding Conchobar who wants her and Fergus who goes into exile over how the wanting ends; NAOISE; and CATHBAD - the corpus held an entire Ulster court and NO DRUID, in a literature where the druid tells everyone what will happen and is always right. DIAN CECHT WITHOUT MIACH AND AIRMED, who are the reason Nuada gets a working hand and his kingship back. NUADA RESTORED WITHOUT BRES, the half-Fomorian king whose reign fills the gap - the most interesting political figure in the material, A KING DEPOSED FOR MEANNESS in a literature where a king's first duty is hospitality. And no AMERGIN, who leads the Milesians and is the man the three goddesses name the island to; with his edge the corpus's Eriu is finally connected to the event she is famous for. THE FRAME OF THE WHOLE CYCLE WAS MISSING, ALL THREE PEOPLE IN IT. Saint Patrick sits with Oisin and listens to his story, and baptises Caoilte. That is the frame of the Acallam na Senorach, the twelfth-century Colloquy of the Ancients, in which the survivors of the Fianna walk around Ireland with Patrick naming places and telling him what happened at each - which is HOW MOST OF THE FENIAN CYCLE SURVIVES. Oisin is also the NARRATOR of the cycle, which is the fault lane 17 found one day earlier with Sanjaya and the Bhagavad Gita: the framing device of a body of literature is itself a character and the registry held neither the character nor the literature, twice, in two unrelated traditions. The Patrick record is THE PATRICK OF THIS LITERATURE and says so on its face; the historical Patrick is not on it. ONE CORRECTION THE TEST SUITE FORCED, THE THIRD LANE RUNNING AND THE SAME ONE. Fionn was authored 'demigod', which is how the tradition treats him; npm test rejected it as tier-classification drift because this corpus computes the tier from DESCENT and his father Cumhall is a mortal, and Oscar two generations down computes 'quartigod'. Lane 16 hit this with Ashwatthama, lane 17 with Shani, lane 18 with two records at once. THE RULE IS NOW UNDERSTOOD AND SHOULD BE APPLIED BEFORE AUTHORING RATHER THAN AFTER TESTING: in this schema type is a function of parentage, not a description of status. TWO THINGS THIS LANE COULD NOT EXPRESS, BOTH ESCALATED. (1) THE GEIS - the machinery of the entire Fenian Cycle, a binding obligation that makes a person act against their own interest, for which this registry has no field. Diarmuid is under one to take Grainne and another never to hunt a boar and both kill him. It is not a relation, not a domain and not an item. (2) THE TRIOS COULD ONLY BE HALF-JOINED: Banba and Fodla carry a symmetric sibling edge to each other and a non-symmetric one-of-the-three-with toward Eriu, and Badb and Macha the same toward the Morrigan, because the honest kind is 'sibling' and it cannot be used - Eriu and the Morrigan are pre-existing records and a symmetric edge would mutate them. THIS IS EXACTLY THE COST LANE 17 NAMED and the first time it has cost the data a genuine SISTERHOOD rather than a rivalry. A SWEEP-TOOL FINDING, RECORDED SO THE NEXT LANE DOES NOT REPEAT IT: 'The Dagda' and 'The Morrigan' returned ABSENT because the corpus files them WITH THE DEFINITE ARTICLE and the normaliser does not strip it - two false absences out of ten hits, a 20 per cent error rate on the hit side. A sweep over this tradition should strip a leading 'the'. The genuinely false hit was 'Net' matching egyptian_neith. ONE WITHIN-TRADITION ID COLLISION handled as in lanes 16 and 17: irish_donn_cuailnge, because irish_donn is the god of the dead. The census flags a second waiting - the Aoife of the Children of Lir is NOT the irish_aife of the Ulster Cycle. REJECTS: the Fianna, the Tuatha De Danann, the Fomorians, the Fir Bolg and the Milesians are PEOPLES; the Salmon of Knowledge is an animal that is eaten; Bran and Sceolang are hounds identified by a name and an owner; Tir na nOg, Emain Macha and Tara are places. Sweep run twice: 81 names first, then 140 after generation - 62 hits, 78 absences, all 28 new records resolving. 19 BLOCKED, of which three are episodes this batch ingests EVERY PARTICIPANT OF and cannot narrate: the curse of Macha, Airmed's herbs, and Dian Cecht's killing of Miach. Zero kinless figures - every one of the 28 carries an edge. npm test 302/302. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-18/irish-census.tsv and irish-audit.md.

First Welsh pass. 40 -> 65 records. THE HEADLINE: SIX REGISTERED ERAS IN A ROW HELD NOTHING AND THE REGISTRY DID NOT HOLD ARTHUR. The Welsh era vocabulary has NINE eras and the corpus held records in THREE - mythic-prehistoric 9, mabinogion-mythological 30, mythological-cycle 1, and then roman-british, post-roman, norman-and-edwardian, late-medieval, early-modern and modern ALL EMPTY. Lane 18 found ONE empty registered era, fenian-cycle, and called it the clearest statement a corpus can make about what it is missing; this lane found SIX IN A ROW, and they are not a random tail - they are exactly the span the Welsh Arthurian material lives in. Culhwch ac Olwen, the Triads, the Three Romances, the Dream of Macsen, the Myrddin poems: everything after the Four Branches had nowhere to be and nobody in it. Two of the six now hold records - roman-british 2, post-roman 18 - and four are flagged forward. A REGISTRY INDEXING 560 TRADITIONS AND 6,421 FIGURES DID NOT HOLD ARTHUR, nor Cai, nor Bedwyr, nor Gwenhwyfar, nor Medrawd, nor Culhwch or Olwen whose tale is the OLDEST ARTHURIAN STORY IN ANY LANGUAGE, nor Myrddin in either form. An 83-name check returned 33 hits and 50 absences, and the 33 hits are almost entirely the Four Branches: THE WELSH HOLDINGS WERE NOT THIN, THEY WERE ONE TEXT DEEP. Arthur is ingested from the WELSH material - the Triads, the Annales Cambriae Camlann entry, Culhwch, Pa Gur - and not from Geoffrey or the French romances, which are a different body of literature about a figure with the same name; the distinction is on the record. THE SAME FAULT AS EVERYWHERE ELSE, INSIDE THE LAYER THE CORPUS DID HOLD WELL, THREE TIMES. (1) ARAWN WITHOUT HAFGAN: the corpus held Arawn king of Annwn and Pwyll who takes his shape for a year and a day, and the only thing that happens in that year is that Pwyll kills HAFGAN with a single blow because a second would heal him. It held the swap and not the reason for it. (2) CERIDWEN WITHOUT MORFRAN: the corpus held Ceridwen, the cauldron, Tegid Foel the father, and TALIESIN - THE SERVANT THE THREE DROPS LANDED ON BY ACCIDENT - and not Morfran, the son the year of brewing was for, nor Creirwy, the beautiful daughter Morfran is ugly compared with. THE REGISTRY HELD THE BENEFICIARY OF AN ACCIDENT AND NOT THE INTENDED RECIPIENT. (3) GWYN AP NUDD HELD WITH AN EMPTY RELATIONS ARRAY: his one story is that he and GWYTHYR fight for CREIDDYLAD every May Day until Judgement Day, and the corpus held neither the other man nor the woman. An empty relations array on a figure whose entire tradition is a relationship is the record-level version of the empty era. And MABON AP MODRON - one of the oldest divine names attested in Britain, the Romano-British Maponos in Welsh dress, the greatest huntsman there is, without whom the Twrch Trwyth cannot be hunted - was absent. TWO MERLINS, AND THE TRADITION SAYS SO ITSELF. By the end of the twelfth century GIRALDUS CAMBRENSIS DISTINGUISHES THEM IN AS MANY WORDS: Merlinus Ambrosius, found at Carmarthen, fatherless, who prophesies the two dragons before Vortigern; and Merlinus Silvester or Celidonius, a northerner, contemporary of Arthur, driven mad at Arfderydd and living out his life in the Caledonian forest. GEOFFREY OF MONMOUTH COMBINED THEM and the combined figure is the one the world knows. A registry that indexes traditions should be able to say that, so this batch ingests TWO RECORDS carrying a symmetric distinguished-by-the-sources-from edge to each other, and NEITHER RECORD ASSERTS THEY ARE THE SAME PERSON AND NEITHER ASSERTS THEY ARE NOT - the merger is recorded as a fact about the sources. Merlin is a census ALIAS row SPANNING BOTH RECORDS, the first alias row in this programme that spans two records rather than sitting on one. GWENHWYFACH, AND A CAMLANN WITH NO LANCELOT IN IT. Triad 53 names the blow Gwenhwyfach struck her sister Gwenhwyfar as one of the Three Harmful Blows and makes it the cause of Camlann - a Welsh account of the end of Arthur court IN WHICH THE ADULTERY DOES NOT APPEAR AT ALL. The Annales Cambriae entry says only that Arthur and Medrawd fell at Camlann; IT DOES NOT SAY THEY FOUGHT EACH OTHER, and both records carry the entry and not the later reading. The corpus now holds a version of Camlann older than the one it would have got from a Galfridian source, and holds Gwenhwyfach, who exists for no other reason. THE BOAR IS INGESTED AND THE BIRDS AND HOUNDS ARE NOT: TWRCH TRWYTH is a KING TRANSFORMED INTO A BOAR FOR HIS SINS, named in the Historia Brittonum three centuries before Culhwch, carrying comb, razor and shears between his ears, who speaks, and whose hunt across Ireland, Wales and Cornwall costs Arthur most of his men - a figure with a history, on the ground lane 18 stated when it took the two bulls of the Tain and rejected five named horses. Adar Rhiannon and the Cwn Annwn are REJECTED in the same batch as collectives of unnamed animals. ZERO PRE-EXISTING RECORDS MUTATED, AND THE COST AGAIN, FOR THE FOURTH LANE RUNNING - and this time it costs a betrothal and a marriage: Creiddylad taken-by Gwyn ap Nudd and Gwythyr perpetual-adversary-of Gwyn ap Nudd, where the honest kinds are symmetric and cannot be used; Creiddylad names her father welsh_lludd_llaw_eraint IN A RELATION AND NOT IN parentIds, the asymmetry lane 15 found with Sohrab and lane 16 with Kaikeyi; and Morfran and Creirwy carry parentIds naming Ceridwen alone, with Tegid Foel fatherhood as prose and a relation. FOUR LANES HAVE NOW REPORTED THIS - it is no longer an observation but a structural property of an append-only corpus, and it is escalated again. TYPE COMPUTED FROM DESCENT, APPLIED BEFORE AUTHORING: lanes 16, 17 and 18 each lost a test cycle to tier-classification drift, this lane applied the rule up front, and NPM TEST PASSED 302/302 ON THE FIRST RUN. Four lanes to internalise a rule the test suite states precisely, and the fix is free once it is applied before authoring rather than after testing. WHAT IS NOT ASSERTED: no identity between the two Myrddins in either direction; NO IDENTIFICATION OF MYRDDIN EMRYS WITH AMBROSIUS AURELIANUS though the name invites it, because whether the boy-prophet is a doubling of Gildas Ambrosius is exactly what the sources leave open - Ambrosius is BLOCKED and carries no edge; no identity between Elen Luyddog and Saint Helena, whom Welsh tradition conflates her with, because they are a fourth-century empress and the wife of Magnus Maximus and the record says the conflation exists rather than adopting it; NO CROSS-TRADITION EDGES for Nodens/Nuada/Nudd, Manawydan/Manannan or Llyr/Lir, on the rule since lane 13 that a shared etymology is a fact about traditions and not a relation between beings, and MAPONOS is recorded on Mabon own etymology rather than as a second record; and no account of what the Twrch Trwyth sin was, because the tale does not say. 18 BLOCKED, OF WHICH MODRON COSTS THE MOST: this batch ingests MABON AP MODRON, a name that MEANS Son, son of Mother, and does not hold the Mother - the patronymic is half the record significance and the other half is missing, which is lane 18 Macha exactly. Six more are strong ADDs held only for a citation and all six are in Culhwch: GLEWLWYD GAFAELFAWR the porter whose doorway dialogue opens the tale, GWRHYR GWALSTAWD IEITHOEDD who speaks to every animal in the Oldest Animals sequence, MENW FAB TEIRGWAEDD who takes the shears from between the boar ears, CUSTENNIN and GOREU without whom this batch ingests Ysbaddaden and cannot narrate his death, and CILYDD and GOLEUDDYDD who would give welsh_culhwch real parentIds. The northern Myrddin material is blocked nearly entire - Gwenddydd, Gwenddoleu, Rhydderch Hael - so the corpus holds Myrddin Wyllt and not the battle that maddens him or the sister the poems are addressed to. AND CYNON FAB CLYDNO, who tells the story of the fountain before Owain rides out, IS THE THIRD FRAMING NARRATOR THIS PROGRAMME HAS FOUND MISSING IN THREE LANES - after Sanjaya and the Bhagavad Gita in lane 17 and Oisin and the Acallam in lane 18. Three unrelated traditions, three literatures whose narrator the registry did not hold; this one is BLOCKED rather than ingested, which is the honest disposition and also the unsatisfying one. REJECTS: Annwn, Dinas Emrys, Caer Siddi are PLACES; Camlann is an EVENT; the Three Harmful Blows is a TEXT; Adar Rhiannon and the Cwn Annwn are COLLECTIVES; the Coraniaid are a PEOPLE; the Thirteen Treasures are OBJECTS; Ysbaddaden forty tasks are a LIST OF TASKS and only the few the tale narrates produce records. Sweep run twice: 83 names first, then 121 after generation - 60 hits, 61 absences, all 25 new records resolving. Zero kinless figures - every one of the 25 carries an edge. npm test 302/302. PARTIAL. Welsh goes from one text deep to five; what remains is Modron, the rest of Culhwch named band, the northern Myrddin cycle, Urien Rheged and the Taliesin praise-poetry which would give the corpus a historical sixth-century layer it has none of, Enid and Luned and the Lady of the Fountain so the Three Romances hold their women, and the four Welsh eras still empty from norman-and-edwardian onward.
